title: Quadratic system proof tester
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $L$ be a finite list of equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements, each specified by a coefficient matrix and a right-hand side. The associated tester uses four query positions, takes addresses from the disjoint union of the $n$ input positions and $2^n+2^{n^2}$ proof positions, and has Boolean answers; it is the tester constructed to check the linearized quadratic system.
hypotheses_covered: A list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements
caveat: The statement defines the tester by composition of auxiliary constructions whose definitions are not supplied, so its precise checking behavior cannot be stated faithfully.
